ranks: Doctor Who (WHO, 2023-10-13): the rest of the set (its top half was walked before), with time travel (rule 701.56), vanishing (702.63) and cards gaining suspend (702.62b) built — and the older cards that waited on them

authored.name: All of History, All at Once
Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

blocked.name: Ace's Baseball Bat
blocked.why: 'must be blocked by a Dalek if able' - only plain must-be-blocked-if-able exists. Also needs a while-attacking condition on the grant.

blocked.name: Adipose Offspring
blocked.why: Emerge isn't modelled (no pool card has it)

blocked.name: Amy Pond
blocked.why: "Choose a suspended card you own and remove that many time counters from it": a choice among suspended cards in exile, then a removal there.

blocked.name: An Unearthly Child
blocked.why: Reveal-until filter 'a card with doctor's companion' — no CardFilter clause reads a card's pairing.

blocked.name: Barbara Wright
blocked.why: Sagas you control have read ahead; read ahead isn't built (nor granting it).

blocked.name: Become the Pilot
blocked.why: "can't be blocked unless it's attacking its owner or a permanent its owner controls": no conditional unblockability by defender

blocked.name: Bill Potts
blocked.why: The activated-ability half ('activate an ability that targets only Bill Potts') — activates-ability has no target filter, and the once-each-turn limit must be shared with the spell half, so two separate triggers won't do.

blocked.name: Blink
blocked.why: II/IV Alien Angel token's 'this token isn't a creature until end of turn' (and loses its creature types, per ruling) has no vocabulary.

blocked.name: Charnel Serenade
blocked.why: "Exile Charnel Serenade with three time counters on it" as it resolves.

blocked.name: Clara Oswald
blocked.why: 'If Clara Oswald is your commander, choose a color before the game begins. Clara Oswald is the chosen color' — no pregame commander color choice (affects color identity too). The Doctor trigger doubler alone is doubleTriggersOf with subtype Doctor.

blocked.name: Confession Dial
blocked.why: Target legendary creature card in your graveyard gains escape (mana cost + exile three others) until end of turn — only grant-flashback exists as a one-shot grant.

blocked.name: Coward // Killer
blocked.why: Coward's time travel is built; Killer's "each other creature that shares a creature type with it" needs sharesCreatureTypeWith keyed to a target slot (it reads only a trigger object).

blocked.name: Cult of Skaro
blocked.why: A modal triggered ability's random mode is picked as it goes on the stack (rule 700.2b); modal.random is resolution-time only.

blocked.name: Cybermat
blocked.why: No 'whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked' trigger (only becomes-blocked / blocked-by).

blocked.name: Dan Lewis
blocked.why: Artifacts become Equipment with 'Equipped creature gets +1/+0' and equip {1}: a static can't grant another static ability (grantsActivated exists, a granted static doesn't).

blocked.name: Davros, Dalek Creator
blocked.why: 'each opponent who lost 3 or more life this turn faces a villainous choice' - turn-stat's who is only you/opponent/any-player, so the choice can't be limited to those opponents.

blocked.name: Day of the Moon
blocked.why: Choose a creature card name, then goad all creatures with any name chosen for this enchantment (names accumulated across chapters); no name choice or per-source name memory.

blocked.name: Death in Heaven
blocked.why: III puts the exiled creature cards onto the battlefield face down as 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures; nothing puts a card from exile face down with set characteristics (manifest/cloak come only from a library). Also needs the chapters' exile to be linked to the Saga.

blocked.name: Deep-Sea Kraken
blocked.why: "Whenever an opponent casts a spell, if this card is suspended, remove a time counter from it": a trigger working from exile.

blocked.name: Dinosaurs on a Spaceship
blocked.why: "Whenever a time counter is removed from this card while it's exiled": a trigger working from exile.

blocked.name: Don't Blink
blocked.why: Until end of turn, creatures that would enter from exile or after being cast from exile are shuffled into their owners' libraries instead — no such replacement effect.

blocked.name: Donna Noble
blocked.why: Soulbond pairing isn't modeled, and the dealt-damage trigger reads 'a creature it's paired with'.

blocked.name: Doomsday Confluence
blocked.why: 'Choose X. You may choose the same mode more than once' - castModal has no X mode count and no repeated modes.

blocked.name: Exterminate!
blocked.why: Replicate (with a tap-an-untapped-Dalek cost) isn't modeled.

blocked.name: Flesh Duplicate
blocked.why: Vanishing is built; the copy exception adding vanishing 3 only if the copied creature lacks vanishing isn't.

blocked.name: Fugitive of the Judoon
blocked.why: III: 'You may exile a Human you control and an artifact you control. If you do, ...' — no may-option exiling two distinct chosen permanents, offered only when both can be exiled.

blocked.name: Gallifrey Falls // No More
blocked.why: Fuse isn't modelled (AUTHORING §12)

blocked.name: Genesis of the Daleks
blocked.why: Chapter IV: 'loses life equal to the total power of Daleks that died this turn' - turnHistory counts died entries but can't sum their power.

blocked.name: Hunted by The Family
blocked.why: Per target, its controller faces a villainous choice; the ruling has them asked in turn order, but for-each-target goes in target order (and nesting each-player-may inside for-each-target is untested).

blocked.name: Ian Chesterton
blocked.why: Saga spells you cast have replicate equal to their mana cost; replicate isn't built (nor granting it, nor Saga spell copies becoming tokens).

blocked.name: Idris, Soul of the TARDIS
blocked.why: Vanishing is built; "Idris has all activated and triggered abilities of the exiled card and gets +X/+X" isn't.

blocked.name: Inspiring Refrain
blocked.why: "Exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it" as it resolves.

blocked.name: Jenny Flint
blocked.why: Training isn't modeled (no keyword, no helper); the rest (first strike, partner with, Clue/Food sacrifice trigger) is authorable.

blocked.name: Jhoira of the Ghitu
blocked.why: "Exile a nonland card from your hand" as a cost, then "put four time counters on the exiled card": the effect has no reference to the card the cost exiled.

blocked.name: Jo Grant
blocked.why: 'Each historic card in your hand has cycling {2}{W}' has no static to grant cycling in hand; 'whenever you cycle a card' has no trigger (only this-cycled).

blocked.name: Judoon Enforcers
blocked.why: "No more than one creature can attack you each combat": no attacker-count limit static

blocked.name: Last Night Together
blocked.why: "Only the chosen creatures can attack during that combat phase": additional-combat has no attacker restriction

blocked.name: Lunar Hatchling
blocked.why: Escape's 'Exile a land you control' part — card.escape is only { cost, exileCount, counters }.

blocked.name: Madame Vastra
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature dealt damage by Madame Vastra this turn dies' has no trigger; also her partner Jenny Flint is blocked.

blocked.name: Me, the Immortal
blocked.why: Counters remain on it as it moves to any zone but hand or library — no such rule; its graveyard cast with a two-card discard is a secondary gap.

blocked.name: Midnight Crusader Shuttle
blocked.why: Villainous option 2: gain control of a creature of your choice, tap it, and 'it's attacking that player' - no effect puts a creature already on the battlefield into combat as an attacker.

blocked.name: Missy
blocked.why: 'return it to the battlefield face down and tapped. It's a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature' - no face-down entry with set characteristics. (Its 'chaos ensues' would be inert.)

blocked.name: Nyssa of Traken
blocked.why: Reflexive 'tap up to that many target creatures' needs a target count fixed by the number sacrificed; any-number max 'x' exists only for a spell's/activated ability's X.

blocked.name: Out of Time
blocked.why: Vanishing is built; "a time counter for each creature that phased out this way" has no this-way count of phasing.

blocked.name: Peri Brown
blocked.why: 'The first historic spell you cast each turn has convoke': convoke is read only from the card definition (def.convoke); grantsToSpells has no convoke grant.

blocked.name: Rassilon, the War President
blocked.why: 'Each noncreature spell you cast from exile has conspire' — conspire isn't modeled (the upkeep impulse half is authorable).

blocked.name: Return the Past
blocked.why: Its ruling: a split card that gains flashback pays only the half being cast; grantsToGraveyard flashback 'mana-cost' reads the whole card's combined manaCost (game.ts flashbacksOf), so Expansion // Explosion and Fuss // Bother would be wrong. Iroh, Grand Lotus and Lier share the defect.

blocked.name: River Song
blocked.why: 'You draw cards from the bottom of your library' has no replacement, and 'whenever an opponent ... searches their library' has no trigger (scry/surveil triggers exist).

blocked.name: Rousing Refrain
blocked.why: "Exile Rousing Refrain with three time counters on it": a resolving spell exiling itself suspended, instead of going to the graveyard.

blocked.name: Run for Your Life
blocked.why: 'They can't be blocked this turn except by creatures with haste' — no until-end-of-turn cantBeBlockedBy effect on targets.

blocked.name: Start the TARDIS
blocked.why: Jump-start isn't built (surveil/draw and the inert planeswalk would be fine).

blocked.name: Strax, Sontaran Nurse
blocked.why: 'Choose a player at random. When you do, Strax fights another target creature that player controls': choose-opponent {random, anyPlayer} exists, but a reflexive trigger's target can't be restricted to the player it chose (reflexive pendingTriggers carry no triggerPlayer).

blocked.name: TARDIS
blocked.why: "the next spell you cast this turn has cascade": grant-spells-this-turn covers every spell this turn, and a nextSpell delayed trigger running cascade uses the source's (TARDIS's) mana value as the threshold and doesn't make the spell have cascade (First Doctor sees it)

blocked.name: The Beast, Deathless Prince
blocked.why: "Whenever a creature deals combat damage to its owner": deals-combat-damage-to-player has no damaged-player-is-the-creature's-owner clause

blocked.name: The Caves of Androzani
blocked.why: II/III: for each non-Saga permanent choose one counter kind on it and may add one of that kind — proliferate adds every kind and isn't per-permanent/filtered.

blocked.name: The Curse of Fenric
blocked.why: II: 'becomes a 6/6 legendary Horror creature named Fenric' — animate can't set a name or add legendary; III's 'named Fenric' then can't be matched.

blocked.name: The Cyber-Controller
blocked.why: Milled creature cards go onto the battlefield face down as 2/2 Cyberman artifact creatures - only manifest/cloak put things face down, and only from the library top as plain 2/2s.

blocked.name: The Day of the Doctor
blocked.why: I-III: exile until a legendary card, playable 'for as long as this Saga remains' — reveal-until can't grant a while-source play permission; IV: choose up to three Doctors then optionally exile all others with 13 damage only if you do.

blocked.name: The Eighth Doctor
blocked.why: One shared once-per-your-turn use over playing a historic land or casting a historic permanent spell from the graveyard, and the permanent gaining 'exile it if it would leave'; castFromGraveyard has neither lands nor the exile replacement.

blocked.name: The Eleventh Hour
blocked.why: III 'a legendary Alien named Prisoner Zero': the ruling says the token loses every non-Alien subtype, Vehicle included; CopyExceptions.setSubtypes replaces only creature types, so a Vehicle/Dryad Arbor copy would keep Vehicle/Forest.

blocked.name: The Face of Boe
blocked.why: Cast a spell with suspend from your hand paying its suspend cost rather than its mana cost — cast-now has no suspend-cost alternative.

blocked.name: The First Doctor
blocked.why: "Whenever you cast a spell with cascade": no cast-trigger filter for a spell having cascade (printed or granted this-cast cascade)

blocked.name: The Five Doctors
blocked.why: 'Search your library and/or graveyard for up to five Doctor cards': beginLibrarySearch forces min 1 when a graveyard match exists (right for 'a card', wrong for 'up to five'), so 'graveyard only, find none, no shuffle' isn't offered.

blocked.name: The Foretold Soldier
blocked.why: 'Whenever this creature deals damage, exile it face down. It becomes foretold.' — no effect foretells a card from the battlefield.

blocked.name: The Fourth Doctor
blocked.why: playFromLibraryTop/castFromLibraryTop have no once-each-turn limit shared by a land play and a cast, nor a 'when you do, create a Food' rider on the permission's use.

blocked.name: The Girl in the Fireplace
blocked.why: II's Horse grants horsemanship (not modeled); III is "whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn" — a delayed trigger over any creature for the rest of the turn.

blocked.name: The Master, Formed Anew
blocked.why: 'enter as a copy of a creature card in exile with a takeover counter on it' - copyOnEnter copies only permanents on the battlefield.

blocked.name: The Master, Gallifrey's End
blocked.why: 'choose an opponent with the most life among your opponents' - choose-opponent can't be limited to the opponents tied for most life.

blocked.name: The Pandorica
blocked.why: "It can't phase in for as long as The Pandorica remains tapped … When The Pandorica becomes untapped or leaves, that permanent phases in": phase-out only has untilSourceLeaves

blocked.name: The Rani
blocked.why: 'create a red Aura enchantment token named Mark of the Rani attached to another target creature' - create-token has no attachedTo.

blocked.name: The Sea Devils
blocked.why: III: until end of turn, whenever any Salamander deals combat damage to a player, it deals that much damage to target creature that player controls — DelayedCombatDamage watches only one object and delayed triggers choose no targets.

blocked.name: The Seventh Doctor
blocked.why: Choose a hidden card in hand, defending player guesses whether its mana value is greater than your artifact count — no guess decision exists.

blocked.name: The Toymaker's Trap
blocked.why: Secretly choose an unused number 1-5, then an opponent guesses it - no secret choice or guess decision.

blocked.name: The Valeyard
blocked.why: Replacement making opponents face a villainous choice twice, and an extra vote (rule 701.38d) - neither is built.

blocked.name: The War Doctor
blocked.why: "Whenever one or more other permanents phase out": no phase-out trigger (AUTHORING §15, rule 603.10b)

blocked.name: The War Games
blocked.why: I: tokens 'goaded for as long as this Saga remains on the battlefield'; only goad-until-your-next-turn and goadedForGame exist.

blocked.name: The Wedding of River Song
blocked.why: "Then target opponent does the same": a hand look-and-choose made by the player in a target slot — for-each-player has no target-slot scope.

blocked.name: Thijarian Witness
blocked.why: "if it was attacking or blocking alone": no filter/condition for a dying creature that attacked or blocked alone (blocking alone too)

blocked.name: This Is How It Ends
blocked.why: The target's OWNER (each-player-may has only controllerOfTarget) chooses 'another creature they own' to shuffle in - no owner scope, and no effect where that player picks a permanent to shuffle.

blocked.name: Time Reaper
blocked.why: 'put target face-up card they own in exile on the bottom of their library' - there's no target spec for a card in exile.

blocked.name: Trial of a Time Lord
blocked.why: IV: no condition comparing two vote tallies (guilty > innocent), and no effect putting every card exiled-until-leaves with this Saga on the bottom of its owner's library.

blocked.name: Truth or Consequences
blocked.why: Secret council: votes are secret then revealed (engine votes are sequential and open), and 'choose an opponent at random'.

blocked.name: Vislor Turlough
blocked.why: 'It's goaded for as long as they control it' — goad lasts until the goader's next turn or forGame; no duration tied to the opponent keeping control (a static goad would make the opponent the goader, which is wrong per 701.15b).

blocked.name: Vrestin, Menoptra Leader
blocked.why: "Whenever you attack with one or more Insects, put a +1/+1 counter on each of them": only an attacking:true filter at resolution, the approximation §15 forbids

blocked.name: Weeping Angel
blocked.why: 'isn't a creature until end of turn' (no type-removing effect), and the prevent-combat-damage-and-shuffle replacement isn't built.

blocked.name: Zygon Infiltrator
blocked.why: "becomes a copy of that creature for as long as that creature remains tapped": become-copy's until has no while-other-tapped duration
